info.title: Ory Kratos API (Mock)
info.description: Mock of Ory Kratos. There is no login endpoint: authentication happens through self-service flows, which are first-class resources. Create a flow, receive an object carrying a renderable ui (action, method, nodes), then submit against that flow id. A failed submission returns 400 with the whole flow re-rendered and numbered messages attached to the offending ui.nodes. Traits are validated against the identity JSON Schema, and continue_with tells the client what to do next. The admin API - which Kratos serves on a separate port - is kept under the /admin prefix, and includes JSON Patch on identities.

get.description:
Return captured request/response logs.

WARNING: the unpaginated default response embeds a full copy of every
response body seen this session and grows without bound — late in a
session it can exceed what client tooling returns intact (long output
is often silently capped). Prefer `/audit/summary` for an overview, or
page through with `limit`/`offset` and `include_body=false` (drops the
bulky `response_body` field; `request_body` is always kept).

Defaults (no params = full dump, bodies included) are kept for
compatibility with the grading harness, which reads this endpoint
parameter-less and asserts on response_body content.
Clear the request log. Returns count of cleared entries.
Return aggregated summary of API usage.

patch.description: JSON Patch (RFC 6902), which Kratos exposes alongside the whole-document PUT.
